thirstwastaken2.config.title: ThirstWasTaken2
thirstwastaken2.config.category.depletio: How fast thirst drains, and what speeds it up or slows it down.
thirstwastaken2.config.category.drinking: Drinking by hand, and what happens to water past a full bar.
thirstwastaken2.config.category.purity.t: The grade collected water gets, and how likely bad water makes you sick.
thirstwastaken2.config.category.sickness: How likely bad water makes you ill on Easy.
How likely bad water makes you ill on Normal.
How likely bad water makes you ill on Hard.
thirstwastaken2.config.category.hud.tool: Where the thirst bar sits, plus the quenched outline and tooltip droplets with AppleSkin.
thirstwastaken2.config.category.items.to: Guessed values for modded drinks, and the file that holds every item's values.
thirstwastaken2.config.thirst_depletion_: How fast thirst drains outside the Nether, before biome climate is applied.
thirstwastaken2.config.nether_thirst_dep: Depletion speed used in the Nether and any other dimension where water evaporates.
thirstwastaken2.config.fire_resistance_d: Percentage of the normal depletion speed applied while Fire Resistance is active.
thirstwastaken2.config.thirst_depletion_: When off, thirst slowly refills instead of draining on Peaceful difficulty.
thirstwastaken2.config.depletes_when_nau: Adds extra thirst exhaustion while the Nausea effect is active.
thirstwastaken2.config.dehydration_halts: Blocks natural health regeneration while thirst is not full.
thirstwastaken2.config.prevent_sprinting: Stops sprinting once thirst drops to 6 or below.
thirstwastaken2.config.can_drink_by_hand: Sneak and use an empty hand on water to drink directly from it.
thirstwastaken2.config.drink_by_hand_nee: Requires both hands to be empty before drinking by hand.
thirstwastaken2.config.extra_thirst_conv: Thirst above the maximum is turned into quenched instead of being lost.
thirstwastaken2.config.hand_drinking_thi: Thirst restored by one drink straight from a water source.
thirstwastaken2.config.hand_drinking_que: Quenched restored by one drink straight from a water source.
thirstwastaken2.config.default_purity.to: Purity used for water that carries no purity of its own.
Purity of the water rain collects in a cauldron.
Purity of the water a pointed dripstone drips into a cauldron.
thirstwastaken2.config.copper_pot_second: Seconds each serving of water in a Copper Hanging Pot over a lit campfire takes to boil pure. A full pot holds three.
thirstwastaken2.config.iron_pot_seconds_: Seconds each serving of water in an Iron Hanging Pot over a lit campfire takes to boil pure. A full pot holds three.
thirstwastaken2.config.sickness_preset.t: Realistic: bad water can give Upset Stomach or Poisoning, more often on harder difficulties. Classic: the old Nausea and Poison, the same on every difficulty.
How much of a drink's quenched water of this purity gives. Bad water fills the bar but not for long.
Chance that one drink of water of this purity poisons you.
thirstwastaken2.config.upset_stomach_cha: Chance that one drink of water of this purity upsets your stomach, when it did not poison you.
thirstwastaken2.config.upset_stomach_lev: Level of Upset Stomach from water of this purity. Poisoning brings the same level with it.
thirstwastaken2.config.thirst_bar_x_offs: Horizontal offset of the thirst bar, in pixels.
thirstwastaken2.config.thirst_bar_y_offs: Vertical offset of the thirst bar, in pixels.
thirstwastaken2.config.appleskin_missing: AppleSkin is not installed, so these settings do nothing for now.
thirstwastaken2.config.appleskin_quenche: Colour of the quenched outline on the thirst bar and in tooltips. Off removes the outline and the exhaustion strip from the bar.
thirstwastaken2.config.appleskin_tooltip: Show the thirst and quenched droplet rows in item tooltips.
thirstwastaken2.config.enable_drink_tag_: Items their own mod tags as drinks restore thirst even when the config does not list them.
thirstwastaken2.config.enable_keyword_ma: Guesses thirst values for unknown modded items from their registry name.
thirstwastaken2.message.salt_water_refus: Sea water would brew salty tea; use fresh water
thirstwastaken2.config.note: Only HUD and AppleSkin settings are client-side; the rest apply on the server.
